text: Cycles Lapierre is a bike brand of the Accell Group, the Dutch bicycle group that also owns Raleigh, Batavus, Sparta, Koga, Haibike, Winora, Ghost, Babboe and XLC.

source.name: Cycling Weekly: Raleigh and Lapierre owner declared bankrupt, potential sale to Irish company on horizon
source.quote: The owner of iconic British bike company Raleigh and French brand Lapierre, the Accell Group, has been declared bankrupt
